title: Commit and publish the epic working tree and validate dirty-path reason codes
description: WHY: main is 5 commits ahead of origin/main and roughly 59 tracked files are modified plus 6 untracked, including core refactor modules - part of the closed milestone exists only as uncommitted working-tree state, and the milestone closeout summary carries no commit SHA, only a dirty-path reason code. That means checkpointGateSatisfaction (packages/engine/src/runtime.ts, checkpoint gate path) accepted a no-commit reason while the repository demonstrably had scoped changes - the whitelisted reason codes (CHECKPOINT_DIRTY_PATH_REASON_CODES) are honor-system. WHAT: (1) review, stage and commit the working tree in coherent commits per subsystem (typecheck fix from the sibling task first so the committed tree builds), push to origin, and attach the SHAs as evidence; (2) also reconcile the memory repo (modified raw/index.jsonl plus untracked generated summaries and wiki files) via the sync-and-doctor workflow; (3) harden the escape hatch - when a closeout summary claims a no-repo-changes style reason code, validate it against actual git status for the scoped paths at summary compose time and reject the reason when tracked scoped files are modified; emit the existing git.checkpoint.required gap on rejection. Cite the reason-code set at packages/engine/src/runtime.ts lines 185-195 (pre-refactor numbering; locate by constant name).
acceptanceCriteria: git status --porcelain is empty on main and origin/main matches local HEAD
Memory repo is clean or its remaining dirt is documented as intentional collaboration state
A closeout summary claiming no_repo_changes while scoped tracked files are modified is rejected, covered by a test
closedReason: published clean root checkpoint and validated dirty-path reason guard
